description: Fleet policy (SHA pinning, immutable Action digests, cooldown, automerge) is inherited from the self-hosted Renovate admin config (rknightion/renovate-config config.js) via autodiscover. Only the repo-specific GoReleaser-version tracker lives here.

packageRules.description: This is a shared-workflows hub: consumers pin the reusables to release SHAs and pick up bumps only when a new release lands. So dependency updates here must cut a release. Renovate's default `chore(deps)` maps to a hidden changelog section, and release-please treats an all-hidden commit set as non-releasing, so those merges never open the release PR. Commit them as `build(deps)` instead - a non-hidden, releasable type (Build & CI section) - so each bump proactively updates the release PR and is visible in the changelog. Repo-scoped on purpose; app repos keep the fleet `chore` default.

customManagers.description: Track the GoReleaser CLI version pinned as the binaries.yml goreleaser-version input default.
